title: Widow Maker
html:
Widow Maker and Widower Hatchlings

Widow Maker (The Widower's Nest, Widow Maker's Lair) Level 20-40

Skills:

  • Widow's Curse (Can't use abilities and mana drained during 10secs)
  • Summon Widower Hatchling
  • Widower Prison (Can't move and Hp drained during 10secs)
  • Knockback Charge

Resistances:

  • Low Poison Resist
  • Immune to Fire
  • Low Ice Resist
  • Good Shadow Resist
  • No Divine Resist

Support

The Widow Maker has the ability to summon groups of Widower's Hatchlings.

For tips on fighting Widow Maker, check out the Widow Maker Boss Guide.

The chest in this lair can roll a short list of named rainbows. Those pieces are on Boss Lair Rainbows.
